parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. You can obtain the resource group ID in the **Resource Management** console.

parameters.name: RetcodeAppId
parameters.description:
The application ID.

Log on to the **ARMS console**. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Browser Monitoring** > **Browser Monitoring**. On the Browser Monitoring page, click the name of an application. The URL in the browser address bar contains the pid of this application in the format of `pid=xxx`. The PID is usually percent encoded as xxx%40xxx. You must modify this value to remove the percent encoding. For example, if the PID in the URL is `xxx%4074xxx`, you must replace **%40** with the at sign (@). The actual PID is `xxx@74xxx`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms search-retcode-app-by-page --retcode-app-name App1 --page-number 1 --page-size 5 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --retcode-app-id eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d0000 --tags Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms SearchRetcodeAppByPage --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value TestValue --PageSize 5 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxyexli20000' --PageNumber 1 --RetcodeAppName App1 --Tags.1.Key TestKey --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RetcodeAppId 'eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d0000'
